svg.title: 29 x 29 print calibration - US Letter
svg.desc: Blank 5 mm grid with two 50 mm rulers. Print actual size and measure on paper. Physical pegboard compatibility has not been tested.
svg.text: US Letter | 215.9 x 279.4 mm paper | nominal 5 mm cells
Print: Actual size / 100%. Turn off Fit, Shrink and borderless enlargement.
Use matching paper, portrait orientation and one page per sheet. Prefer the PDF.
29 cells = 145 mm; first-to-last cell centres = 140 mm.
Measure both axes on the printed sheet
with a separate ruler, centre to centre.
If either ruler is not 50 mm, check paper size and scaling, then print again.
If content is clipped, use a printer that can print this area; do not scale to fit.
If both rulers match, compare cell centres with your actual peg spacing in both axes.
If pegs do not align, use row/column counting. This is not a universal pegboard template.
Digital dimensions checked; physical printing and pegboard fit have not been tested.
